title: Signage & UI / Atlas artwork
summary: Ten Basement signs, Wet Floor and A Clean Start, with editable lettering. [Download the atlas-ready SVGs](sources/mascot-signage-revision.zip) · [Revision and palette](MASCOT_SIGNAGE_REVISION.md) · [Original artwork](BASEMENT_SIGNAGE_STAGE5.md).

items.title: Twelve editable signs
items.alt: Comparison of the twelve current sign and poster designs
items.body: [Download the SVG set](sources/mascot-signage-revision.zip) · [Original comparison sheet](media/basement-signs-stage5/basement-signs-overview.webp) · [Original Basement PNGs](sources/basement-signs-stage5.zip).

items.title: 01 / Employees Only
items.alt: Wide cream and bottle-green Employees Only plaque with the wizard and staff
items.body: The left-pointing wizard and slim divider leave the staff-access label as the main read. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/01-employees-only.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/01-employees-only.png).

items.title: 02 / Restricted Area
items.alt: Square cream Restricted Area placard with charcoal text, a safety-yellow stripe, a wizard giving a stop signal and a padlock
items.body: The safety-yellow stripe, padlock and stop-signal wizard identify a controlled door. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/02-restricted-area.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/02-restricted-area.png).

items.title: 03 / Keep Out / Authorized Personnel Only
items.alt: Oxide-red and cream Keep Out sign with Authorized Personnel Only and a small wizard giving a stop signal
items.body: The oxide-red band emphasizes the prohibition, with the qualification and the stop-signal wizard below. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/03-keep-out.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/03-keep-out.png).

items.title: 04 / Equipment
items.alt: Cream and green Equipment sign with the approved wizard pushing a cleaning cart
items.body: The approved **Pushing equipment** pose sits in the cream panel beside the single-word EQUIPMENT label. The file keeps its original name for existing atlas links. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/04-cleaning-equipment.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/04-cleaning-equipment.png).

items.title: 05 / Chemical Spill / Keep Clear
items.alt: Yellow Chemical Spill sign with a wizard stepping in an acid puddle and three vapor trails
items.body: The wizard’s boot meets the puddle in one continuous contour. Three vapor trails rise above the spill. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/05-chemical-spill.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/05-chemical-spill.png).

items.title: 06 / Service Stairs
items.alt: Long cream Service Stairs sign with a downward arrow and the mascot carrying supplies
items.body: The approved Carrying supplies pose stays in the left panel and the arrow carries the downward direction. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/06-service-stairs.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/06-service-stairs.png).

items.title: 07 / Return Tools / After Use
items.alt: Square Return Tools After Use notice with a cream mopping wizard in a green pictogram field
items.body: The approved Mopping pose anchors the dark green field against the stacked instruction. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/07-return-tools.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/07-return-tools.png).

items.title: 08 / Danger / Toxic Vapors
items.alt: Safety-yellow Toxic Vapors sign with a pointed-ear goblin skull in a diamond
items.body: The traced goblin skull keeps the pointed ears and diamond frame of the selected vapor warning. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/08-toxic-vapors-goblin.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/08-toxic-vapors-goblin.png).

items.title: 09 / Low Clearance / Watch Your Head
items.alt: Amber Low Clearance sign with a tusked orc ducking under an overhead beam
items.body: The traced orc, beam and downward chevrons retain the original low-clearance cue. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/09-low-clearance-orc.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/09-low-clearance-orc.png).

items.title: 10 / Quiet Please / Test in Progress
items.alt: Cream Quiet Please sign with an elf holding a finger to its lips, eyes closed
items.body: The elf holds a finger to its lips with closed eyes, marking the testing room as a quiet area. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/10-quiet-testing-elf.svg) · [Original PNG](media/basement-signs-stage5/10-quiet-testing-elf.png).

items.title: Hazard / Wet Floor
items.alt: Standalone black and yellow wet-floor sign with a slipping wizard
items.body: The four-digit slipping pose sits on the shared safety-yellow background above the diagonal stripe band. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/wet-floor.svg) · [Original PNG](media/signage-ui-stage5-raster-review/wet-floor.png).

items.title: Corporate poster / A clean start
items.alt: 1970s poster with a greeting wizard, stepped green orange and mustard stripes, and bold dark green lettering
items.body: The approved Greeting pose sits inside the orange circle above the stepped stripes and editable two-line slogan. [Editable SVG](sources/mascot-signage-revision/Signage_Atlas/clean-start-poster.svg) · [Original PNG](media/signage-ui-stage5-raster-review/clean-start-02.png).
